provenance: CommonsenseQA dev accuracy, verbatim from Zelikman et al. 2022 'STaR: Bootstrapping Reasoning With Reasoning' (arXiv:2203.14465), Table 1: GPT-J few-shot direct 20.9%, GPT-J few-shot CoT 36.6%, GPT-J direct finetuned 60.0%, STaR without rationalization 68.8% (rationales generated for 69.7% of the training set), STaR with rationalization 72.5% (86.7% of the training set), GPT-3 direct finetuned 73.0%. x encodes the method: 0=few-shot direct, 1=few-shot CoT, 2=GPT-J finetuned, 3=STaR w/o rationalization, 4=STaR, 5=GPT-3 finetuned (the 30x-larger comparison).
